howThisWorks: Consumers are DERIVED from the code corpus by scripts/check-structure/authoritative-stream-read-inventory.mjs.
This file never decides what exists: an undiscovered entry is stale and a new call site fails closed.
It only classifies the sites that declare, in source, that a bounded prefix IS the contract.
Complete-history readers need no entry -- they call readCompleteStream from @chase-sets/event-core/complete-stream.
Every entry names the test that consumes its declared bound, and that test must cite the entry id.
